intro.en: In this letter a father advises his son, a young man starting university, to look at his friends and sort them. Some friends help your religion and your life, some help only one, and some help neither. The father compares friends to air, food, medicine, wine and disaster.
intro.ur: Is khat mein ek walid apne bete, jo jawan hai aur university shuru kar raha hai, ko nasihat karte hain ke apne doston ko dekhe aur unhein qismon mein baante. Kuch dost deen aur dunya dono mein faida dete hain, kuch sirf ek mein, aur kuch kisi mein nahin. Walid doston ko hawa, ghiza, dawa, sharab aur museebat se tashbeeh dete hain.
intro.ar: في هَذِهِ الرِّسالَةِ يَنْصَحُ أَبٌ وَلَدَهُ الشّابَّ الَّذي يَبْدَأُ دِراسَتَهُ في الجامِعَةِ أَنْ يَنْظُرَ في أَصْدِقائِهِ وَيُصَنِّفَهُمْ: مِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَنْفَعُ الدّينَ وَالدُّنْيا، وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَنْفَعُ أَحَدَهُما، وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ لا يَنْفَعُ بِشَيْءٍ. وَيُشَبِّهُهُمُ الأَبُ بِالهَواءِ وَالغِذاءِ وَالدَّواءِ وَالخَمْرِ وَالبَلاءِ.

dialogue.ar: إِلى وَلَدي العَزيزِ خالِدٍ، سَلامٌ عَلَيْكَ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكاتُهُ.
dialogue.tr: ilā waladī l-ʿazīzi khālidin, salāmun ʿalayka waraḥmatu Allāh wabarakātuh.
dialogue.en: To my dear son Khalid, peace, mercy and blessings of Allah be upon you.
dialogue.ur: Mere pyare bete Khalid, tum par Allah ki salamati, rahmat aur barkat ho.

dialogue.ar: يا بُنَيَّ، أَنْتَ الآنَ شابٌّ تَدْخُلُ الجامِعَةَ، وَسَتَلْقى فيها أَصْدِقاءَ كَثيرينَ.
dialogue.tr: yā bunayya, anta l-ʾāna shābbun tadkhulu l-jāmiʿata, wasatalqā fīhā aṣdiqāʾa kathīrīn.
dialogue.en: My son, you are now a young man entering university, and you will meet many friends there.
dialogue.ur: Beta, ab tum jawan ho aur university mein ja rahe ho, wahan tumhein bohat se dost milenge.

dialogue.ar: وَأَوَّلُ ما أَنْصَحُكَ بِهِ أَنْ تَعْرِفَ أَنَّ الصُّحْبَةَ لَيْسَتْ نَوْعاً واحِداً، بَلْ أَصْنافٌ مُخْتَلِفَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: waʾawwalu mā anṣaḥuka bihi an taʿrifa anna ṣ-ṣuḥbata laysat nawʿan wāḥidan, bal aṣnāfun mukhtalifatun.
dialogue.en: The first thing I advise you is to know that companionship is not one kind but different kinds.
dialogue.ur: Sab se pehli nasihat yeh hai ke jaan lo ke sohbat ek hi qism ki nahin, balke mukhtalif qismon ki hoti hai.

dialogue.ar: فَاجْلِسْ يَوْماً مَعَ وَرَقَةٍ وَقَلَمٍ، وَاكْتُبْ أَسْماءَ أَصْحابِكَ وَرُفَقائِكَ وَجُلَسائِكَ، ثُمَّ صَنِّفْهُمْ.
dialogue.tr: fājlis yawman maʿa waraqatin waqalamin, wāktub asmāʾa aṣḥābika warufaqāʾika wajulasāʾik, thumma ṣannifhum.
dialogue.en: So sit one day with paper and pen, write the names of your friends, companions and sitting-mates, and then sort them.
dialogue.ur: Kisi din kaghaz aur qalam le kar baitho, apne doston, saathiyon aur humnasheenon ke naam likho, phir unhein qismon mein baanto.

dialogue.ar: وَاسْأَلْ نَفْسَكَ عَنْ كُلِّ واحِدٍ: هَلْ هُوَ صالِحٌ في نَفْسِهِ؟ وَهَلْ هُوَ مُخْلِصٌ لَكَ، أَمينٌ عَلى سِرِّكَ، صادِقٌ في كَلامِهِ؟
dialogue.tr: wāsʾal nafsaka ʿan kulli wāḥidin: hal huwa ṣāliḥun fī nafsih? wahal huwa mukhliṣun lak, amīnun ʿalā sirrik, ṣādiqun fī kalāmih?
dialogue.en: Ask yourself about each one: Is he good in himself? Is he sincere to you, trustworthy with your secret, truthful in his speech?
dialogue.ur: Har ek ke bare mein apne aap se poocho: kya woh khud nek hai? Kya woh tumhare liye mukhlis, tumhare raaz ka ameen aur apni baat mein sachcha hai?

dialogue.ar: فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يُفيدُكَ في دينِكَ وَدُنْياكَ مَعاً، وَهَذا كَالهَواءِ الَّذي لا تَسْتَغْني عَنْهُ لَحْظَةً.
dialogue.tr: faminhum man yufīduka fī dīnika waduniyāka maʿan, wahadhā ka-l-hawāʾi alladhī lā tastaghnī ʿanhu laḥẓatan.
dialogue.en: Among them is one who benefits you in your religion and your worldly life together, and he is like air, which you cannot do without for a moment.
dialogue.ur: Un mein koi aisa hai jo deen aur dunya dono mein tumhein faida deta hai; woh hawa ki tarah hai jis ke baghair ek lamha bhi nahin guzarta.

dialogue.ar: وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ هُوَ كَالغِذاءِ، تَجِدُ عِنْدَهُ العِلْمَ وَالعَمَلَ، فَتَقْوى بِصُحْبَتِهِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.
dialogue.tr: waminhum man huwa ka-l-ghidhāʾ, tajidu ʿindahu l-ʿilma wa-l-ʿamal, fataqwā biṣuḥbatihi kulla yawmin.
dialogue.en: Among them is one like food: you find knowledge and good work with him, and you grow stronger through his company every day.
dialogue.ur: Un mein koi ghiza ki tarah hai: us ke paas ilm aur amal milta hai aur us ki sohbat se tum roz mazboot hote ho.

dialogue.ar: وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ هُوَ كَالدَّواءِ، لا تَطْلُبُهُ إِلّا عِنْدَ الضَّرورَةِ، فَيَنْفَعُكَ في ساعَةِ الحاجَةِ ثُمَّ تَتْرُكُهُ.
dialogue.tr: waminhum man huwa ka-d-dawāʾ, lā taṭlubuhu illā ʿinda ḍ-ḍarūrati, fayanfaʿuka fī sāʿati l-ḥājati thumma tatrukuh.
dialogue.en: Among them is one like medicine: you seek him only when necessary, he helps you at the hour of need, and then you leave him.
dialogue.ur: Un mein koi dawa ki tarah hai: tum use sirf zaroorat ke waqt dhoondte ho, woh haajat ke waqt faida deta hai phir tum use chhor dete ho.

dialogue.ar: وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ هُوَ كَالخَمْرِ، حَديثُهُ حُلْوٌ وَمَظْهَرُهُ زينَةٌ، لَكِنَّهُ يُضَيِّعُ عَقْلَكَ وَوَقْتَكَ وَدينَكَ.
dialogue.tr: waminhum man huwa ka-l-khamr, ḥadīthuhu ḥulwun wamaẓharuhu zīnatun, lākinnahu yuḍayyiʿu ʿaqlaka wawaqtaka wadīnak.
dialogue.en: Among them is one like wine: his talk is sweet and his appearance is a decoration, but he wastes your mind, your time and your religion.
dialogue.ur: Un mein koi sharab ki tarah hai: us ki baatein meethi aur zahiri shakl zeenat wali hai, magar woh tumhari aqal, waqt aur deen ko zaya karta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ هُوَ كَالبَلاءِ، فَهُوَ أَحْمَقُ لا يُحْسِنُ التَّفْكيرَ، أَوْ فاحِشُ اللِّسانِ يُؤْذي مَنْ حَوْلَهُ.
dialogue.tr: waminhum man huwa ka-l-balāʾ, fahuwa aḥmaqu lā yuḥsinu t-tafkīr, aw fāḥishu l-lisāni yuʾdhī man ḥawlah.
dialogue.en: Among them is one like a calamity: a fool who cannot think well, or one with an indecent tongue who harms those around him.
dialogue.ur: Un mein koi museebat ki tarah hai: ahmaq jo achhi tarah soch nahin sakta, ya badzubaan jo apne aas paas walon ko takleef deta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَاحْذَرِ الصّاحِبَ الَّذي يَخونُ سِرَّكَ إِذا غِبْتَ، وَيُسَلِّمُ عَلَيْكَ بِوَجْهٍ وَيَذُمُّكَ بِآخَرَ.
dialogue.tr: wāḥdhari ṣ-ṣāḥiba alladhī yakhūnu sirraka idhā ghibt, wayusallimu ʿalayka biwajhin wayadhummuka biʾākhar.
dialogue.en: Beware of the companion who betrays your secret when you are away, who greets you with one face and speaks ill of you with another.
dialogue.ur: Us saathi se bacho jo tumhari ghairhaziri mein tumhara raaz kholta hai, ek chehre se salam karta hai aur doosre se burai karta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ يَبْدو لَكَ صَديقٌ حَسَنُ المَظْهَرِ صاحِبُ مالٍ وَزينَةٍ، وَلَكِنَّ المَظْهَرَ لَيْسَ مِقْياساً لِلصُّحْبَةِ.
dialogue.tr: waqad yabdū laka ṣadīqun ḥasanu l-maẓhari ṣāḥibu mālin wazīnatin, walakinna l-maẓhara laysa miqiyāsan lilṣṣuḥbati.
dialogue.en: A friend may seem to you good-looking, with wealth and finery, but appearance is not a measure of companionship.
dialogue.ur: Mumkin hai koi dost khoobsurat, maaldaar aur zeenat wala nazar aaye, magar zahiri shakl sohbat ka paimana nahin.

dialogue.ar: فَاجْعَلْ مِقْياسَكَ في الصَّديقِ أَنْ يُقَرِّبَكَ إِلى اللهِ، وَميزانَكَ أَنْ يَزيدَكَ خَيْراً كُلَّما جَلَسْتَ مَعَهُ.
dialogue.tr: fājʿal miqiyāsaka fī ṣ-ṣadīqi an yuqarribaka ilā Allā, wamīzānaka an yazīdaka khayran kullamā jalasta maʿah.
dialogue.en: Make your measure in a friend that he brings you closer to Allah, and your scale that he adds goodness to you every time you sit with him.
dialogue.ur: Dost mein tumhara paimana yeh ho ke woh tumhein Allah se qareeb kare, aur tarazu yeh ke jab bhi us ke saath baitho woh tumhein khair mein badhaye.

dialogue.ar: وَكُنْ أَنْتَ أَيْضاً صَديقاً صالِحاً؛ فَالصُّحْبَةُ أَخْذٌ وَعَطاءٌ، وَمَنْ أَرادَ أَخاً صادِقاً فَلْيَكُنْ صادِقاً.
dialogue.tr: wakun anta ayḍan ṣadīqan ṣāliḥan; fa-ṣ-ṣuḥbatu akhdhun waʿaṭāʾun, waman arāda akhan ṣādiqan falyakun ṣādiqan.
dialogue.en: And be a good friend yourself; companionship is give and take, and whoever wants a truthful brother should be truthful.
dialogue.ur: Aur tum khud bhi achhe dost bano; sohbat lena aur dena hai, jo sachcha bhai chahta hai woh khud sachcha ho.

dialogue.ar: وَاللهَ أَسْأَلُ أَنْ يَرْزُقَكَ الصُّحْبَةَ الصّالِحَةَ، وَيُسْعِدَكَ بِها في الدُّنْيا وَالآخِرَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wa-l-lha asʾalu an yarzuqaka ṣ-ṣuḥbata ṣ-ṣāliḥata, wayusʿidaka bihā fī d-duniyā wa-l-ʾākhirati.
dialogue.en: And I ask Allah to grant you good companions and make you happy with them in this world and the next.
dialogue.ur: Main Allah se dua karta hoon ke woh tumhein nek sohbat naseeb kare aur dunya aur aakhirat mein tumhein un se khush rakhe.

dialogue.ar: وَالسَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَبيكَ المُحِبِّ.
dialogue.tr: wa-s-salāmu ʿalayka min abīka l-muḥibbi.
dialogue.en: And peace be upon you, from your loving father.
dialogue.ur: Aur tum par salam ho, tumhare mohabbat karne wale abbu ki taraf se.

vocab.en: he is useful to, he helps

options: helps you in religion and worldly life

q.en: How many kinds of companions does the writer summarise?
q.ur: Mussannif ne saathiyon ki kitni qismein khulase mein bayan ki hain?

options: That he brings us closer to Allah

q.en: Which word means "trustworthy"?
q.ur: "Amanatdaar" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?

intro.en: The small word «لا» is used in many ways. It can forbid («لا تُهْمِلْ» – do not neglect), deny a verb, deny a whole kind of thing («لا رَيْبَ فيهِ» – there is no doubt in it), work like «لَيْسَ», be extra with no effect, or simply answer "no" to a question.
intro.ur: Chhota sa lafz «لا» kai tarah istemal hota hai. Yeh mana kar sakta hai («لا تُهْمِلْ» – ghaflat na karo), fail ki nafi kar sakta hai, poori jins ki nafi («لا رَيْبَ فيهِ» – is mein koi shak nahin), «لَيْسَ» ki tarah amal kar sakta hai, ya zaid ho sakta hai, ya sawal ka jawab "nahin" ho sakta hai.
intro.ar: لِكَلِمَةِ «لا» اسْتِعْمالاتٌ كَثيرَةٌ: فَقَدْ تَنْهى مِثْلَ «لا تُهْمِلْ»، أَوْ تَنْفي الفِعْلَ، أَوْ تَنْفي الجِنْسَ كُلَّهُ مِثْلَ «لا رَيْبَ فيهِ»، أَوْ تَعْمَلُ عَمَلَ «لَيْسَ»، أَوْ تَكونُ زائِدَةً لا أَثَرَ لَها، أَوْ تَكونُ جَواباً بِمَعْنى «لا» عَلى سُؤالٍ.

dialogue.ar: لا تَكْسَلْ في دِراسَتِكَ يا بُنَيَّ.
dialogue.tr: lā taksal fī dirāsatika yā bunayya.
dialogue.en: Do not be lazy in your studies, my son. («لا» of prohibition)
dialogue.ur: Beta, apni parhai mein susti na karo. («لا» nahi ka)

dialogue.ar: لا تُفارِقْ إِخْوَتَكَ وَقْتَ الشِّدَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: lā tufāriq ikhwataka waqta sh-shiddati.
dialogue.en: Do not leave your brothers in time of hardship.
dialogue.ur: Mushkil ke waqt apne bhaiyon ko na chhoro.

dialogue.ar: لا يُهْمِلُ الطَّبيبُ مَرْضاهُ.
dialogue.tr: lā yuhmilu ṭ-ṭabību marḍāh.
dialogue.en: The doctor does not neglect his patients. («لا» negating a verb)
dialogue.ur: Doctor apne mareezon ko nazar-andaz nahin karta. («لا» fel ki nafi)

dialogue.ar: لا رَيْبَ في صِدْقِ هَذا الرَّجُلِ.
dialogue.tr: lā rayba fī ṣidqi hādhā r-rajul.
dialogue.en: There is no doubt in this man's honesty. («لا» negating the whole class)
dialogue.ur: Is aadmi ki sachchai mein koi shak nahin. («لا» jins ki nafi)

dialogue.ar: لا رَجُلٌ في الدّارِ وَلا امْرَأَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: lā rajulun fī d-dāri walā mraʾatun.
dialogue.en: There is neither a man nor a woman in the house. («لا» working like «لَيْسَ»)
dialogue.ur: Ghar mein na koi mard hai na aurat. («لا» «لَيْسَ» ki tarah)

dialogue.ar: هَلْ أَنْتَ مُسافِرٌ اليَوْمَ؟ لا.
dialogue.tr: hal anta musāfirun l-yawm? lā.
dialogue.en: Are you travelling today? No. («لا» as an answer)
dialogue.ur: Kya aap aaj safar kar rahe hain? Nahin. («لا» jawab ke tor par)

dialogue.ar: أَحَضَرَ المُدَيرُ؟ لا.
dialogue.tr: aḥaḍara l-mudaīr? lā.
dialogue.en: Has the manager come? No.
dialogue.ur: Kya manager aa gaye? Nahin.

vocab.en: negating the whole class (no ... at all)

q.en: In «لا تَكْسَلْ في دِراسَتِكَ», what kind of «لا» is it?
q.ur: «لا تَكْسَلْ في دِراسَتِكَ» mein «لا» kis qism ka hai?
q.ar: في «لا تَكْسَلْ في دِراسَتِكَ» ما نَوْعُ «لا»؟

q.ur: «لا رَيْبَ فيهِ» kis ki misal hai?

intro.en: Part one is a sermon addressed to young people about choosing friends; part two is a short story called «طُرْفَة». After listening you mark each sentence true or false. The lesson ends with a writing task: prepare a short speech (خُطْبَة) on a topic you choose.
intro.ur: Pehla hissa naujawanon ke naam khutba hai jo dost chunne ke baare mein hai; doosra hissa chhoti kahani «طُرْفَة» hai. Sun kar har jumle ko sahih ya ghalat batana hota hai. Aakhir mein likhne ka kaam hai: apni pasand ke mauzu par chhota khutba tayyar karo.
intro.ar: الجُزْءُ الأَوَّلُ خُطْبَةٌ لِلشَّبابِ عَنِ اخْتِيارِ الأَصْدِقاءِ، وَالثّاني قِصَّةٌ قَصيرَةٌ اسْمُها «طُرْفَة». بَعْدَ الِاسْتِماعِ تَحْكُمُ عَلى كُلِّ جُمْلَةٍ بِصَحيحٍ أَوْ خَطَأٍ. وَيَنْتَهي الدَّرْسُ بِتَمْرينِ كِتابَةٍ: حَضِّرْ خُطْبَةً قَصيرَةً في مَوْضوعٍ تَخْتارُهُ.

dialogue.ar: الصّاحِبُ يُشْبِهُ صاحِبَهُ في أَخْلاقِهِ، فَاخْتَرْ جَليسَكَ كَما تَخْتارُ طَعامَكَ.
dialogue.tr: aṣ-ṣāḥibu yushbihu ṣāḥibahu fī akhlāqih, fākhtar jalīsaka kamā takhtāru ṭaʿāmak.
dialogue.en: A companion resembles his companion in character, so choose your sitting-mate as you choose your food.
dialogue.ur: Saathi apne saathi ke akhlaaq jaisa hota hai, is liye apna humnasheen waise chuno jaise apna khana chunte ho.

dialogue.ar: قَدْ يَجُرُّ العاصِي مَنْ قَلَّدَهُ إِلى أَوْزارٍ كَثيرَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: qad yajurru l-ʿāṣī man qalladahu ilā awzārin kathīratin.
dialogue.en: A disobedient person may drag the one who imitates him into many burdens of sin.
dialogue.ur: Nafarman shakhs apni naqal karne wale ko bohat se gunahon ke bojh ki taraf kheench sakta hai.

dialogue.ar: حَثَّ الخَطيبُ في خُطْبَتِهِ أَوْلِياءَ الأُمورِ عَلى مَلْءِ فَراغِ أَبْنائِهِمْ بِما يَنْفَعُهُمْ.
dialogue.tr: ḥaththa l-khaṭību fī khuṭbatihi awliyāʾa l-ʾumūri ʿalā malʾi farāghi abnāʾihim bimā yanfaʿuhum.
dialogue.en: In his sermon the preacher urged the guardians to fill their children's free time with what benefits them.
dialogue.ur: Khateeb ne apne khutbe mein sarparaston ko targhib di ke woh apne bachchon ka faarigh waqt mufeed kaamon se bharein.

dialogue.ar: عَزَمَ رَجُلٌ عَلى السَّفَرِ لِزِيارَةِ أَخيهِ، فَاسْتَوْدَعَ جارَهُ كيساً فيهِ دَنانيرُ.
dialogue.tr: ʿazama rajulun ʿalā s-safari liziyārati akhīh, fāstawdaʿa jārahu kīsan fīhi danānīr.
dialogue.en: A man resolved to travel to visit his brother, and entrusted his neighbour with a bag of dinars.
dialogue.ur: Ek aadmi ne apne bhai se milne ke liye safar ka irada kiya aur apne padosi ke paas dinaron ka ek thaila amanat rakha.

dialogue.ar: وَلَمّا عادَ طَلَبَ الكيسَ فَأَنْكَرَ الجارُ أَنَّهُ أَخَذَ شَيْئاً، فَذَهَبَ المُشْتَكي إِلى القاضِي إِياسٍ.
dialogue.tr: walammā ʿāda ṭalaba l-kīsa faʾankara l-jāru annahu akhadha shayʾan, fadhahaba l-mushtakī ilā l-qāḍī iyāsin.
dialogue.en: When he returned he asked for the bag, but the neighbour denied he had taken anything, so the complainant went to the judge Iyas.
dialogue.ur: Wapas aa kar us ne thaila maanga to padosi ne inkaar kar diya, chunancha shikayat karne wala qazi Iyas ke paas gaya.

dialogue.ar: فَقالَ القاضِي لِلْمُشْتَكي: اِرْجِعْ إِلَيَّ غَداً، وَلا تَحْكِ لِأَحَدٍ ما جَرى.
dialogue.tr: faqāla l-qāḍī lilmushtakī: irjiʿ ilayya ghadan, walā taḥki liʾaḥadin mā jarā.
dialogue.en: The judge said to the complainant: Come back to me tomorrow, and tell no one what happened.
dialogue.ur: Qazi ne shikayat karne wale se kaha: Kal mere paas wapas aana aur kisi ko mat batana ke kya hua.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ أَحْضَرَ الجارَ وَقالَ لَهُ بِهُدوءٍ: إِنَّ صاحِبَكَ يَعودُ غَداً، فَهَلْ لَكَ ما تَقولُهُ لَهُ؟
dialogue.tr: thumma aḥḍara l-jāra waqāla lahu bihudūʾin: inna ṣāḥibaka yaʿūdu ghadan, fahal laka mā taqūluhu lah?
dialogue.en: Then he brought the neighbour and said calmly: Your friend comes back tomorrow; do you have anything to say to him?
dialogue.ur: Phir us ne padosi ko bulaya aur sukoon se kaha: Tumhara saathi kal wapas aayega, kya tumhein us se kuch kehna hai?

dialogue.ar: يا زَوْجي، رُدَّ الأَمانَةَ إِلى صاحِبِها قَبْلَ أَنْ يَعْلَمَ القاضِي بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ.
dialogue.tr: yā zawjī, rudda l-ʾamānata ilā ṣāḥibihā qabla an yaʿlama l-qāḍī bikulli shayʾin.
dialogue.en: My husband, give the trust back to its owner before the judge learns everything.
dialogue.ur: Mere shauhar, amanat us ke maalik ko wapas kar do, pehle iske ke qazi sab kuch jaan le.

intro.en: «كادَ» and its sisters work like «كانَ»: they take a subject (اسْم) and a predicate (خَبَر), but the predicate is usually a present-tense verb. There are three groups. Nearness: «كادَ الثَّلْجُ يَذوبُ» (the snow was about to melt). Hope: «عَسى الغَمامُ أَنْ يُمْطِرَ» (perhaps the clouds will rain). Starting: «شَرَعَ الطُّلّابُ يَكْتُبونَ» (the students began to write).
intro.ur: «كادَ» aur us ki behnein «كانَ» ki tarah kaam karti hain: un ka ism aur khabar hota hai, magar khabar aam tor par fel-e-mudari hoti hai. Teen guroh hain. Muqaraba: «كادَ الثَّلْجُ يَذوبُ» (barf pighalne hi wali thi). Rajaa: «عَسى الغَمامُ أَنْ يُمْطِرَ» (shayad badal barsein). Shuru: «شَرَعَ الطُّلّابُ يَكْتُبونَ» (talba ne likhna shuru kiya).
intro.ar: «كادَ» وَأَخَواتُها تَعْمَلُ عَمَلَ «كانَ»: لَها اسْمٌ وَخَبَرٌ، وَالخَبَرُ فِعْلٌ مُضارِعٌ غالِباً. وَهِيَ ثَلاثُ مَجْموعاتٍ: المُقارَبَةُ مِثْلَ «كادَ الثَّلْجُ يَذوبُ»، وَالرَّجاءُ مِثْلَ «عَسى الغَمامُ أَنْ يُمْطِرَ»، وَالشُّروعُ مِثْلَ «شَرَعَ الطُّلّابُ يَكْتُبونَ».

dialogue.ar: كادَ الثَّلْجُ يَذوبُ.
dialogue.tr: kāda th-thalju yadhūb.
dialogue.en: The snow was about to melt. (nearness)
dialogue.ur: Barf pighalne hi wali thi. (muqaraba)

dialogue.ar: أَوْشَكَتِ الحافِلَةُ أَنْ تَتَحَرَّكَ.
dialogue.tr: awshakati l-ḥāfilatu an tataḥarrak.
dialogue.en: The bus was about to move.
dialogue.ur: Bus chalne hi wali thi.

dialogue.ar: كَرَبَتِ الشَّمْسُ تَغيبُ.
dialogue.tr: karabati sh-shamsu taghīb.
dialogue.en: The sun was about to set.
dialogue.ur: Suraj doobne hi wala tha.

dialogue.ar: عَسى الغَمامُ أَنْ يُمْطِرَ غَداً.
dialogue.tr: ʿasā l-ghamāmu an yumṭira ghadan.
dialogue.en: Perhaps the clouds will rain tomorrow. (hope)
dialogue.ur: Shayad kal badal barsein. (rajaa)

dialogue.ar: حَرى الطَّبيبُ أَنْ يَصِلَ قَريباً.
dialogue.tr: ḥarā ṭ-ṭabību an yaṣila qarīban.
dialogue.en: The doctor is likely to arrive soon.
dialogue.ur: Doctor ka jaldi pohanchna mumkin hai.

dialogue.ar: اخْلَوْلَقَ الجَوُّ أَنْ يَصْفُوَ.
dialogue.tr: khlawlaqa l-jawwu an yaṣfuw.
dialogue.en: The weather is likely to clear.
dialogue.ur: Mausam saaf hone wala hai.

dialogue.ar: شَرَعَ الطُّلّابُ يَكْتُبونَ الاخْتِبارَ.
dialogue.tr: sharaʿa ṭ-ṭullābu yaktubūna l-ākhtibār.
dialogue.en: The students began to write the test. (starting)
dialogue.ur: Talba ne imtihan likhna shuru kiya. (shuru)

dialogue.ar: طَفِقَ الرَّعْدُ يَقْصِفُ.
dialogue.tr: ṭafiqa r-raʿdu yaqṣif.
dialogue.en: The thunder began to roar.
dialogue.ur: Bijli ki garaj shuru ho gayi.

dialogue.ar: جَعَلَتِ الأُمُّ تُعِدُّ العَشاءَ.
dialogue.tr: jaʿalati l-ʾummu tuʿiddu l-ʿashāʾ.
dialogue.en: The mother began to prepare dinner.
dialogue.ur: Ammi ne raat ka khana tayyar karna shuru kiya.

dialogue.ar: أَقْبَلَ الفَلّاحُ يَحْصُدُ القَمْحَ.
dialogue.tr: aqbala l-fallāḥu yaḥṣudu l-qamḥ.
dialogue.en: The farmer began to harvest the wheat.
dialogue.ur: Kisan ne gandum ki fasal kaatni shuru ki.

title.en: Extensive reading: In the Holy Land

intro.en: In this travel account a son performs Umrah with his elderly father, in Makkah and then Madinah. They circle the Kaaba, walk between Safa and Marwa, and visit al-Baqi' and the graves of the martyrs of Uhud. The text is rich in emotion and in new vocabulary.
intro.ur: Is safarnamay mein ek bete ne apne boorhe walid ke saath Makkah aur phir Madina mein umrah ada kiya. Woh Kaaba ka tawaf karte hain, Safa aur Marwa ke darmiyan sai karte hain aur Baqi aur Uhud ke shuhada ke qabristan ki ziyarat karte hain. Matn jazbaat aur naye alfaaz se bharpoor hai.
intro.ar: في هَذِهِ الرِّحْلَةِ يُؤَدّي اِبْنٌ العُمْرَةَ مَعَ أَبيهِ العَجوزِ في مَكَّةَ ثُمَّ في المَدينَةِ. يَطوفانِ بِالكَعْبَةِ، وَيَسْعَيانِ بَيْنَ الصَّفا وَالمَرْوَةِ، وَيَزورانِ البَقيعَ وَمَقْبَرَةَ شُهَداءِ أُحُدٍ. وَالنَّصُّ غَنِيٌّ بِالعاطِفَةِ وَالمُفْرَداتِ الجَديدَةِ.

dialogue.ar: وَصَلْنا إِلى مَكَّةَ المُكَرَّمَةِ بَعْدَ العِشاءِ، وَكانَتِ السَّماءُ صافِيَةً وَالقُلوبُ تَخْفِقُ شَوْقاً.
dialogue.tr: waṣalnā ilā makkata l-mukarramati baʿda l-ʿishāʾ, wa kānati s-samāʾu ṣāfiyatan wa-l-qulūbu takhfiqu shawqan.
dialogue.en: We reached Makkah al-Mukarramah after the night prayer; the sky was clear and our hearts beat with longing.
dialogue.ur: Hum Isha ke baad Makkah Mukarramah pohanche; aasman saaf tha aur dil shauq se dhadak rahe the.

dialogue.ar: دَخَلْتُ الحَرَمَ مَعَ أَبي العَجوزِ، وَهُوَ يَتَّكِئُ عَلى عُكّازِهِ وَيَمْشي في بُطْءٍ.
dialogue.tr: dakhaltu l-ḥarama maʿa abī l-ʿajūz, wahuwa yattakiʾu ʿalā ʿukkāzihi wayamshī fī buṭʾin.
dialogue.en: I entered the Haram with my old father, who leaned on his crutch and walked slowly.
dialogue.ur: Main apne boorhe abbu ke saath Haram mein dakhil hua, woh apni baisakhi par tek lagaye aahista aahista chal rahe the.

dialogue.ar: هاهُنا، قُرْبَ المَطافِ، تَذَكَّرْتُ هاجَرَ وَابْنَها إِسْماعيلَ عَلَيْهِما السَّلامُ حينَ كانَ الوادِي بِلا ماءٍ.
dialogue.tr: hāhunā, qurba l-maṭāf, tadhakkartu hājara wābnahā ismāʿīla ʿalayhimā s-salāmu ḥīna kāna l-wādī bilā māʾin.
dialogue.en: Here, near the place of circling, I remembered Hajar and her son Ismail, peace be upon them, when the valley had no water.
dialogue.ur: Yahan, tawaf ki jagah ke qareeb, mujhe Hajra aur un ke bete Ismail (alaihimassalam) yaad aaye jab wadi mein pani nahin tha.

dialogue.ar: وَهاهُنا بِئْرُ زَمْزَمَ الَّتي تَتَدَفَّقُ مُنْذُ قُرونٍ فَلا تَغيضُ، وَيَشْرَبُ مِنْها الحُجّاجُ وَالمُعْتَمِرونَ.
dialogue.tr: wahāhunā biʾru zamzama allatī tatadaffaqu mundhu qurūnin falā taghīḍ, wayashrabu minhā l-ḥujjāju wa-l-muʿtamirūn.
dialogue.en: And here is the well of Zamzam which has gushed for centuries without drying up, and pilgrims and Umrah-goers drink from it.
dialogue.ur: Aur yahan Zamzam ka kuan hai jo sadiyon se phoot raha hai aur kam nahin hota, hajji aur umrah karne wale us ka pani peete hain.

dialogue.ar: طُفْنا بِالكَعْبَةِ سَبْعَةَ أَشْواطٍ، وَالنّاسُ حَوْلَنا مِنْ كُلِّ لَوْنٍ وَلُغَةٍ، وَكانَ الزِّحامُ شَديداً وَالقُلوبُ هادِئَةً.
dialogue.tr: ṭufnā bi-l-kaʿbati sabʿata ashwāṭin, wa-n-nāsu ḥawlanā min kulli lawnin walughatin, wakāna z-ziḥāmu shadīdan wa-l-qulūbu hādiʾatan.
dialogue.en: We circled the Kaaba seven rounds, with people around us of every colour and language; the crowd was heavy but hearts were calm.
dialogue.ur: Humne Kaaba ke saat chakkar lagaye, hamare charon taraf har rang aur zubaan ke log the; bheed bohat thi magar dil pur-sukoon the.

dialogue.ar: وَما أَجْمَلَ الكَعْبَةَ في رِدائِها الأَسْوَدِ! فَقَدْ كَساها المُسْلِمونَ مُنْذُ القَديمِ حُبّاً وَتَعْظيماً.
dialogue.tr: wamā ajmala l-kaʿbata fī ridāʾihā l-ʾaswad! faqad kasāhā l-muslimūna mundhu l-qadīmi ḥubban wataʿẓīman.
dialogue.en: How beautiful the Kaaba is in its black covering! Muslims have clothed it since ancient times out of love and veneration.
dialogue.ur: Kaaba apne kaale ghilaf mein kitna khoobsurat hai! Musalman qadeem zamane se mohabbat aur taazeem mein use ghilaf pehnate aaye hain.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ سَعَيْنا بَيْنَ الصَّفا وَالمَرْوَةِ، وَتَذَكَّرْتُ سَعْيَ هاجَرَ حينَ بَحَثَتْ عَنِ الماءِ لِوَلَدِها.
dialogue.tr: thumma saʿaynā bayna ṣ-ṣafā wa-l-marwati, watadhakkartu saʿya hājara ḥīna baḥathat ʿani l-māʾi liwaladihā.
dialogue.en: Then we did the Sa'i between Safa and Marwa, and I remembered the running of Hajar when she searched for water for her son.
dialogue.ur: Phir humne Safa aur Marwa ke darmiyan sai ki aur mujhe Hajra ki daud yaad aayi jab unhon ne apne bete ke liye pani talash kiya.

dialogue.ar: وَكانَ الشَّلَلُ قَدْ أَصابَ ساقَ أَبي قَبْلَ سَنَواتٍ، فَما أَدْري مِنْ أَيْنَ جاءَتْهُ هَذِهِ القُوَّةُ، حَتّى بَدا كَأَنَّهُ يَطيرُ بَيْنَ العَلَمَيْنِ.
dialogue.tr: wakāna sh-shalalu qad aṣāba sāqa abī qabla sanawātin, famā adrī min ayna jāʾathu hādhihi l-quwwatu, ḥattā badā kaʾannahu yaṭīru bayna l-ʿalamayn.
dialogue.en: Paralysis had struck my father's leg years before, and I do not know where this strength came from, until he seemed to fly between the two markers.
dialogue.ur: Kuch saal pehle abbu ki taang par falij gira tha, mujhe nahin pata yeh taqat kahan se aayi, yahan tak ke woh dono nishanon ke darmiyan udte hue lagte the.

dialogue.ar: وَمِنَ المَسْجِدِ الحَرامِ ارْتَفَعَ صَوْتُ المُؤَذِّنِ عَذْباً نَدِيّاً، فَتَوَقَّفَ الزِّحامُ، وَاصْطَفَّ النّاسُ صُفوفاً.
dialogue.tr: wamina l-masjidi l-ḥarāmi rtafaʿa ṣawtu l-muʾadhdhini ʿadhban nadiyyan, fatawaqqafa z-ziḥām, wāṣṭaffa n-nāsu ṣufūfan.
dialogue.en: From the Sacred Mosque rose the voice of the muezzin, sweet and moving; the crowd stopped and people lined up in rows.
dialogue.ur: Masjid-e-Haram se muazzin ki meethi aur dil ko chhune wali awaz buland hui, bheed ruk gayi aur log safon mein khade ho gaye.

dialogue.ar: وَبَعْدَ أَيّامٍ شَدَدْنا الرِّحالَ إِلى المَدينَةِ المُنَوَّرَةِ، وَكُنّا نَرى النَّخيلَ مِنْ نَوافِذِ الحافِلَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wabaʿda ayyāmin shadadnā r-riḥāla ilā l-madīnati l-munawwarati, wakunnā narā n-nakhīla min nawāfidhi l-ḥāfilati.
dialogue.en: After some days we set out for Madinah al-Munawwarah, seeing palm trees from the bus windows.
dialogue.ur: Kuch din baad hum ne Madina Munawwara ka rakht-e-safar bandha, aur bus ki khidkiyon se khajoor ke darakht dikhayi dete the.

dialogue.ar: في المَسْجِدِ النَّبَوِيِّ سَلَّمْنا عَلى رَسولِ اللهِ ﷺ، وَتَذَكَّرْتُ ما لَقِيَ أَصْحابُهُ في مَكَّةَ مِنَ الهَوانِ فَصَبَروا. وَتَذَكَّرْتُ قَوْلَهُ ﷺ لِآلِ ياسِرٍ:
dialogue.tr: fī l-masjidi n-nabawiyyi sallamnā ʿalā rasūli Allāh ﷺ, watadhakkartu mā laqiya aṣḥābuhu fī makkata mina l-hawāni faṣabarū. watadhakkartu qawlahu ﷺ liʾāli yāsirin:
dialogue.en: In the Prophet's Mosque we greeted the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and I remembered the humiliation his Companions met in Makkah and how they were patient. And I remembered his words ﷺ to the family of Yasir:
dialogue.ur: Masjid-e-Nabawi mein humne Rasoolullah ﷺ ko salam kiya aur mujhe yaad aaya ke Makkah mein sahaba ne kitni zillat dekhi aur sabr kiya. Aur Aal-e-Yasir se un ﷺ ka farman yaad aaya:

dialogue.ar: صَبْراً آلَ ياسِرٍ، فَإِنَّ مَوْعِدَكُمُ الجَنَّةُ.
dialogue.tr: ṣabran ʾāla yāsirin, faʾinna mawʿidakumu l-jannatu.
dialogue.en: Patience, family of Yasir, for your appointed place is Paradise.
dialogue.ur: Sabr karo Aal-e-Yasir, kyunke tumhara thikana jannat hai.

dialogue.ar: وَزُرْنا مَقْبَرَةَ البَقيعِ، وَدَعَوْنا لِلصَّحابَةِ، ثُمَّ مَضَيْنا إِلى مَقْبَرَةِ شُهَداءِ أُحُدٍ.
dialogue.tr: wazurnā maqbarata l-baqīʿ, wadaʿawnā lilṣṣaḥābati, thumma maḍaynā ilā maqbarati shuhadāʾi uḥudin.
dialogue.en: We visited the graveyard of al-Baqi', prayed for the Companions, and then went on to the graveyard of the martyrs of Uhud.
dialogue.ur: Humne Baqi ke qabristan ki ziyarat ki, sahaba ke liye dua ki, phir Uhud ke shuhada ke qabristan gaye.

dialogue.ar: وَقُبَيْلَ الوَداعِ وَقَفْتُ أَتَضَرَّعُ إِلى اللهِ أَنْ يَكْتُبَ لَنا العَوْدَةَ إِلى هاهُنا مَرّاتٍ كَثيرَةً.
dialogue.tr: waqubayla l-wadāʿi waqaftu ataḍarraʿu ilā Allāh an yaktuba lanā l-ʿawdata ilā hāhunā marrātin kathīratan.
dialogue.en: Just before the farewell I stood begging Allah to write for us a return to this place many times.
dialogue.ur: Rukhsat se zara pehle main Allah se girgira kar dua karta raha ke woh humein yahan bar bar wapas aana naseeb kare.

dialogue.ar: وَالآنَ، وَنَحْنُ في طَريقِنا إِلى المَطارِ، أَنْظُرُ إِلى أَبي فَأَراهُ يَبْتَسِمُ كَما لَمْ يَبْتَسِمْ مِنْ قَبْلُ.
dialogue.tr: wa-l-ʾān, wanaḥnu fī ṭarīqinā ilā l-maṭār, anẓuru ilā abī faʾarāhu yabtasimu kamā lam yabtasim min qabl.
dialogue.en: And now, on our way to the airport, I look at my father and see him smiling as he never smiled before.
dialogue.ur: Aur ab, airport ke raaste mein, main abbu ko dekhta hoon to woh is tarah muskura rahe hain jaise pehle kabhi nahin muskuraye.

intro.en: This section is the third test of the book (units 9 to 12). It has reading passages with questions, grammar practice on «لا», «كادَ» and its sisters, and vocabulary. Here you review a short passage about Salman al-Farisi and the Trench, and the word «العَوْلَمَة» (globalisation).
intro.ur: Yeh hissa kitab ka teesra imtihan hai (wahdat 9 se 12). Is mein sawalon ke saath parhne ke matan, «لا» aur «كادَ» aur us ki behnon ki mashq, aur alfaz hain. Yahan Salman al-Farsi aur Khandaq par chhota matan, aur lafz «العَوْلَمَة» (globalisation) ki dohrai hai.
intro.ar: هذا القِسْمُ هُوَ الِاخْتِبارُ الثّالِثُ في الكِتابِ (الوَحَداتُ مِنَ التّاسِعَةِ إِلى الثّانِيَةَ عَشْرَةَ). فيهِ نُصوصٌ لِلْقِراءَةِ مَعَ أَسْئِلَةٍ، وَتَمارينُ عَلى «لا» وَ«كادَ» وَأَخَواتِها، وَمُفْرَداتٌ. نُراجِعُ هُنا نَصّاً قَصيراً عَنْ سَلْمانَ الفارِسِيِّ وَالخَنْدَقِ، وَكَلِمَةَ «العَوْلَمَة».

dialogue.ar: كانَ سَلْمانُ الفارِسِيُّ صَحابِيّاً جَليلاً مِنْ أَهْلِ أَصْبَهانَ، تَرَكَ دِيارَهُ وَطَوَّفَ في البِلادِ باحِثاً عَنِ الدّينِ الحَقِّ.
dialogue.tr: kāna salmānu l-fārisiyyu ṣaḥābiyyan jalīlan min ahli aṣbahān, taraka diyārahu waṭawwafa fī l-bilādi bāḥithan ʿani d-dīni l-ḥaqqi.
dialogue.en: The Companion Salman al-Farisi grew up in Isfahan, then travelled for years searching for the true religion.
dialogue.ur: Sahabi Salman al-Farisi Isfahan ke rehne wale the, unhon ne apna watan chhoda aur deen-e-haq ki talash mein mulk mulk ghoome.

dialogue.ar: وَبَعْدَ أَنْ هاجَرَ الرَّسولُ ﷺ جاءَهُ سَلْمانُ يَتَحَرّى صِفاتِهِ، فَآمَنَ بِهِ وَلازَمَ صُحْبَتَهُ.
dialogue.tr: wabaʿda an hājara r-rasūlu ﷺ jāʾahu salmānu yataḥarrā ṣifātih, faʾāmana bihi walāzama ṣuḥbatah.
dialogue.en: When the Prophet ﷺ migrated to Madinah, Salman checked his signs, became a Muslim and stayed by his side.
dialogue.ur: Jab Rasoolullah ﷺ ne Yathrib ki taraf hijrat ki to Salman un ke paas aaye, un ki sifaat ko parkha, imaan laye aur un ke saath rahe.

dialogue.ar: وَحينَ حُوصِرَتِ المَدينَةُ اقْتَرَحَ سَلْمانُ خُطَّةً: أَنْ يَحْفِرَ المُسْلِمونَ خَنْدَقاً حَوْلَها.
dialogue.tr: waḥīna ḥūṣirati l-madīnatu qtaraḥa salmānu khuṭṭatan: an yaḥfira l-muslimūna khandaqan ḥawlahā.
dialogue.en: When Madinah was besieged, Salman suggested a plan: that the Muslims dig a trench around it.
dialogue.ur: Jab Madina ka muhasira hua to Salman ne ek tajweez di: Musalman us ke ird gird khandaq khodein.

dialogue.ar: فَقُسِّمَ الحَفْرُ بَيْنَ المُسْلِمينَ، وَكانَ لِكُلِّ جَماعَةٍ عَدَدٌ مِنَ الأَذْرُعِ.
dialogue.tr: faqussima l-ḥafru bayna l-muslimīn, wakāna likulli jamāʿatin ʿadadun mina l-ʾadhruʿ.
dialogue.en: The digging was divided among the Muslims, and each group had a number of cubits.
dialogue.ur: Khudai musalmanon mein taqseem hui aur har jamaat ke hisse mein kuch zira aaye.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ جَعَلَهُ عُمَرُ أَميراً عَلى المَدائِنِ، فَكانَ يُنْفِقُ ما يَأْخُذُهُ مِنْ بَيْتِ المالِ صَدَقَةً.
dialogue.tr: thumma jaʿalahu ʿumaru amīran ʿalā l-madāʾin, fakāna yunfiqu mā yaʾkhudhuhu min bayti l-māli ṣadaqatan.
dialogue.en: The caliph Umar appointed him over al-Mada'in, and he used to give his allowance from the treasury in charity.
dialogue.ur: Phir Umar ne unhein Mada'in ka ameer banaya aur woh baitul maal se jo milta use sadqa kar dete the.

dialogue.ar: العَوْلَمَةُ مُصْطَلَحٌ شاعَ في نِهايَةِ القَرْنِ العِشْرينَ، وَمَعْناهُ تَقارُبُ العالَمِ وَاخْتِصارُ المَسافاتِ.
dialogue.tr: al-ʿawlamatu muṣṭalaḥun shāʿa fī nihāyati l-qarni l-ʿishrīn, wamaʿnāhu taqārubu l-ʿālami wākhtiṣāru l-masāfāt.
dialogue.en: "Globalisation" is a term that became common at the end of the twentieth century, meaning the world drawing closer and distances shrinking.
dialogue.ur: Alamgeeriyat (globalisation) ek istilah hai jo beesveen sadi ke aakhir mein aam hui, us ka matlab hai duniya ka qareeb aana aur faasle sukadna.

dialogue.ar: وَساعَدَ الحاسوبُ وَالشَّبَكَةُ الدَّوْلِيَّةُ وَوَسائِلُ الاتِّصالِ عَلى انْتِشارِها بَيْنَ الشُّعوبِ.
dialogue.tr: wasāʿada l-ḥāsūbu wa-sh-shabakatu d-dawliyyatu wawasāʾilu l-āttiṣāli ʿalā ntishārihā bayna sh-shuʿūb.
dialogue.en: The computer, the international network and the means of communication helped it spread among peoples.
dialogue.ur: Computer, aalami network aur rabte ke zaraye ne use qaumon mein phailane mein madad ki.
